Method of Attack: Hides on web servers, steals credit card information, encrypts it with a hardcoded public key, hides encrypted data inside image files using steganography, and sends the encrypted data to attacker-controlled servers
Intercepts credit card data on server-side during user submission
Uses steganography to hide stolen data inside image files placed in public folders
Uses a special user agent to track infected sites
Attack Vector: Hacker gains access to Magento store via brute-forcing or exploiting vulnerabilities in unpatched websites
Indicators of Compromise: Image files in public folders with names such as 'bkg_btn-close2_bg.gif', 'btn_back_bg_bg.gif', 'btn_cancel_bg_bg.gif', 'left_button_back.gif', 'mage.jpg', 'nav1_off_bg.gif', 'notice-msg_bg.png', 'section_menu_link_bg_bg.gif', 'sort-arrow-down_bg.png'
